title: Cer-Eval: Certifiable and Cost-Efficient Evaluation Framework for LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on the statistical methodology and sample complexity of evaluating LLMs, proposing a framework called Cer-Eval to reduce the cost of evaluation. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a primary subject; its only mention of these topics is as examples of external benchmarks or within a brief impact statement at the end.
